name: @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-passport-prototype
description: Standalone prototype for Midnight Passport actor flows

scripts.lint: npm run lint:packages && npm run lint:local
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:packages && npm run lint:fix:local
scripts.all: npm run test:packages && npm run typecheck:local && npm run test:ci:local && npm run state:generate
scripts.clean: npm run clean:packages && npm run clean:local
scripts.build:deps: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-passport && npm run build -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-passport-secret && npm run build -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-compliance
scripts.test:packages: npm run all -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-passport && npm run all -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-passport-secret && npm run all -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-compliance
scripts.lint:packages: npm run lint -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-passport && npm run lint -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-passport-secret && npm run lint -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-compliance
scripts.lint:fix:packages: npm run lint:fix -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-passport && npm run lint:fix -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-passport-secret && npm run lint:fix -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-compliance
scripts.clean:packages: npm run clean -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-passport && npm run clean -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-passport-secret && npm run clean -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-compliance
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials && npm run build -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-same-holder && npm run build -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-iso-registry && npm run build -w @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did-credentials-openid
